name: Playing Cards
overview: Scripture encourages believers to pursue honest and diligent labor rather than vanity or gain through questionable means, emphasizing the value of work done with integrity (Proverbs 13:11). Christians are called to seek peace and build up one another in love, avoiding association with unfruitful works of darkness and instead reproving them (Romans 14:19; Ephesians 5:11). Our thoughts should dwell on what is true, pure, and honorable, reflecting a Christ-centered mindset (Philippians 4:8), while trusting in God's justice rather than taking vengeance into our own hands (Romans 12:19). Ultimately, the gospel reminds us of God's love and the eternal life offered through faith in Christ (John 3:16).
